*Dear Veltech Students,*

*As you dive into the new semester, consider the power of internships to
enhance your college experience.*

"Supercharge your career with IBM, Microsoft, and IIT-B Upskilling. *Register
now* for a transformative journey to professional success!"
*https://forms.gle/23cCMpGiPbmPEcT17 <https://forms.gle/23cCMpGiPbmPEcT17>*

Exciting opportunities await you with our upcoming training program,
designed to propel your skills and career to new heights. Here are the
program highlights that make it a must-attend:

Program Highlights:

*✅**Dual Mentorship:* Benefit from the expertise of *two subject
mentors* dedicated
to your outcome-driven training.

*✅**Comprehensive Training:* Dive deep with over *40 hours* of intensive
learning, ensuring you master the subject matter.

*✅**Hands-On Experience*: Apply your knowledge in real-world scenarios with
10+ practical sessions for invaluable hands-on experience.

*✅** Certifications*: Earn a prestigious *Course Completion Certificate *from
IIT-B (Wissenaire) powered by WIPRO, along with an *Internship Completion
Certificate* from our collaborating companies, also powered by WIPRO.

*✅**Recognition:* Stand out with a *Letter of Recommendation (LOR)* based
on your outstanding performance during the program.

*✅**Community Access*: Join a thriving community offering *stipend-based
internship opportunities and placement assistance* for your post-training
journey.
